I’ve been a loyal client of B Street for quite some time, spending quite a bit on veterinary care, vaccinations, and dental surgery. I’ve continued coming back because I trust the vets, appreciate the pricing, and, most importantly, value the consistency of care for my dogs.

Yesterday, I brought in my two dogs for allergy shots. Both are established patients with updated exams, and since B Street advertises walk-ins, I asked the front desk about the wait time. I was met with a “I don’t know,” with no further explanation or attempt to help.

I understand that emergencies happen and wait times fluctuate. However, asking about wait times at a walk-in clinic is hardly an uncommon question. My frustration isn't that I couldn't be seen immediately; it's how dismissively a reasonable question was handled by a business I've continued to support.

I appreciate the manager reaching out afterward, but our conversation left my biggest concern unanswered. The manager explained that wait times can be unpredictable because the office accommodates emergencies, walk-ins, and appointments. I understand that, but it raises a fair question: If you advertise walk-ins and can't always provide an accurate wait time, what are your front desk staff instructed to tell clients who ask? If “I don't know” isn't the standard response, why was that the response I received? I would have been perfectly understanding of an estimate with the caveat that emergencies could cause delays. Basic communication and courtesy go a long way.

I also didn't appreciate being told that a clinic closer to my new home might be a better fit. One of my dogs is fearful, reactive, and can become aggressive, which is precisely why I value consistency in veterinary care. Seeing familiar faces, visiting the same environment, and having a predictable experience can make a meaningful difference in my dog's long-term comfort and success at the vet. My priority isn't finding the closest clinic; it's finding a veterinary team that prioritizes my animals' well-being. I am more than willing to make the commute and invest in their care to achieve that. I continued choosing B Street because I believed that consistency was worth it.

To be fair, not everyone at the front desk is unwelcoming. There are genuinely helpful staff members, and I recognize that the front desk appears overburdened. I believe there are systemic issues that need attention, particularly around wait times, communication, and the client experience. I also found it disappointing that I had to ask for a manager rather than being offered a way to resolve my concern in-house.

I trust the veterinarians, which makes this especially disappointing. Good veterinary care isn't just about what happens in the exam room; how clients and their animals are treated throughout the experience matters, too. I won't be returning except in an emergency. I believe B Street has missed out on a long-term client who was happy to invest in her animals' care. It's unfortunate that an interaction that could have been resolved with basic professionalism has resulted in the loss of that trust.

I had an Amazing experience here yesterday when Dr. Molena (I hope I got the spelling correct) treated my big black beautiful 10 years young cat 🖤. After Soho's guardian passed away last February, myself and another neighbor have been feeding her. I consider myself the primary care giver and as such noticed that she had a UTI and took her to B Street Veterinary Hospital. Since UTIs are lethal if untreated Soho was given immediate attention when I walked through B Street's door. Dr. Molena was kind, considerant and very gentle. Soho hadn't been in a carrier or vehicle in more than 9 years so she was less than happy to have traveled the 8 miles to get to the vet, yowling all the way there. She was stressed and sick. But the care she received was wonderful. I was a bit shocked by the billing - it was so low! There was no up selling for things that were not related to the UTI. Absolutely amazing. As a past cat "owner" I've been to four other vets in San Diego - B Street has been my best experience in almost 30 years. Thank you to Everyone on staff who I crossed paths with. I am grateful for each of you. Soho is feeling purrfect now and that is all due to the loving and competent care she received at B Street.
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to know you had a positive experience with us.
Very good service
Hi Gerardo! Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to know you had a positive experience with us.
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to know you had a positive experience with us.

I am a retired veterinarian and I'm not easily impressed.
But this veterinary facility practices excellent medicine and surgery.
Not only that, they are very caring and you can tell they care deeply for your pet. As well as educating you about your pet. My dog Stella had a digit amputation do to a tumor.
Love this vet.
Sending you positive vibes. We are here for you!

It was a truly wonderful place; as a first-time visitor, I was impressed by how the staff and doctors treated both me and my dog with the utmost respect and made the entire process easy. I've decided to switch my primary vet to this location.

I bring both of my pups here. The staff here are phenomenal and I'm forever grateful. They saved one of my pups from parvo without them I wouldn't even have him. Prices are expected to be what they are let's just say that. Make sure you guys have insurance cuz that's the main thing. I will continue to be coming for regular pup visits cuz this is my go to spot.

My family and I just want to Thank Dr. V so much... We had went to 4 vet visit to find out what was wrong with our pomeranian Ares and i felt like we just kept getting the run around n taken for our money and finally the VCA Ontario was able to help us and let us know what was wrong with him and Dr Woodcock referred us to Dr V at B Street Hospital.. and by this time he needed emergency surgery to save his life or to be put down and hes only 3years old and has alot of life to live, and we wanted to fight for him and DrV and her staff took such good care of our boy and got us in the new morning she saved him and we appreciate her so much and couldn't be more thankful that we still have him here with us.. It was such a long drive to get to her 2.5hrs. The drive and traffic with 2dogs and a 5.5 month old was so worth it because now hes back to himself now playing, running, messing with his brother tail wagging and all like nothing every happen Dr V is truly a blessing 🙌 I could go on n on with how thankful we are.. Dr V you and your staff are a blessing and we appreciate you all so much thank u thank u from my family and I....

So, I had to write about my experience here, a couple months back.

The wait wasn’t too bad… if you get there early and prepare yourself… it’s not too bad..
I did have some issues w the receptionist as she talks to you like a transaction and replies w “yeah”,
a lot. . which is not professional.
Anways, the appearance I got when I went into the room…. was that it was ghetto.
Raggedy , old towels …placed on the counter… a huge chip on the plastic, red clipboard, they use- Raised some red flags.
What wasn’t ok was when I stood up to the young female Doctor (Long hair), for how they handled my furbaby….

Toxic businesses and companies  protect their employees rather than customers/ guests and that’s Not Ok..

She protected her team, instead of my cat and placing her hands on her hips, to intimidate me.
I called her out on it and she quickly adjusted.
And, then said gently  that it was the environment of the Hospital ( everything is compact , not a lot of space )
…instead of taking accountability for her team.

At B Street, my cat screamed all the way from the hallway and I KNEW it was her, as I waited in the room, praying the whole time she was with them.
I asked for her Immediately.

How I was treated here was not ok and was very Unprofessional.
It’s Unfortunate coz talking to the young Doctor, at first, was a good vibe….

The nurse was telling me my cat tried to bite them.
I had my cat for a very long time and that’s not her character.
My cat would only act like that if she was feeling unsafe…

I Also, went to the VCA, shortly after here, and they didn’t need to use Anesthesia to take my cat’s X-rays….. because the Doc knew how to handle her.
My cat is the most gentle sweet baby.

Since, vet costs are high, I was told about this place, as they do it for cheap.
But, it’s not worth the price if they treat you and your pets like this and don’t take Accountability for it.
The team there is quiet amazing. Even though it wasn't a fun visit (we had to hospitalize our cat) We were met with compassion and great care. Highly recommend coming in here!

I brought my dog in because he had a seizure for the first time ever and the staff was very quick to triage him to make sure he was stable. Then proceeded to take him back to do labs and x rays in a timely manner.

Dr. Keene explained prognosis and gave multiple options for treatment. I felt so comfortable and at peace with the treatment option she felt was best for my dog.

Dr. Keene and the entire staff were sensitive to me and validated my feelings around the situation- I walked in very stressed and scared since it was the first time I ever experienced this.

After a few days Dr. Keene even followed up via email to check in on my dog.

I highly recommend this clinic for the fur babies.

We are new to the area so we unfortunately aren’t established at any vet yet. Somehow B Street was recommended from another vet, primarily because they do walk ins.
However, this was the absolute biggest waste of my time. The front desk is completely unorganized and unprofessional which creates a lot of chaos in an already stressful situation.
My dog had been having diarrhea for a couple of days so I took him in around 11:30. The check-in process is very confusing and outdated and there seems to be no proper triage process because the sick pets are stuck waiting in the lobby while pets coming in for routine vaccines are being seen first.
While waiting in the lobby for 2 hours, I saw a dog be returned to the owner without them getting the treatment that had already been paid for. One of the front desk girls had to call the owner after she had left with her dog so she could come back and get the necessary treatment for her dog.
After my dog was finally taken back, I waited for 3 hours before a vet called me to discuss why my dog was there. The vet was the only helpful person. But I know now that my dog had been in a kennel for 3 hours before being looked at. The doctor told me my dog would be ready at 4:15 for pickup.
When I got there around 4, one of the front desk ladies shouted to everyone in the lobby “if you’re here for pick ups sign in because I don’t have time for that right now!” Mind you, they close at 6 so discharging the pets is exactly what she should’ve been focusing on. After about 30 minutes they said my dog was ready and they would go get him. Another 30 minutes went by, so I asked them if someone could bring him out because I was told he was ready. Turns out they hadn’t started any of the fluids or given him any of the meds they were supposed to. We left around 6 o clock and he blew out diarrhea everywhere the second we walked out of the building. Which tells me they had my dog for over 6 hours and didn’t take him outside once to go to the bathroom, even though they knew he was there for frequent diarrhea.
This place is borderline abusive to animals and all of the pets there look terrified. Don’t ever take your pet here. Especially if it is an emergency. Your animal will be in a kennel the whole time and suffering more than they need to be. I don’t know how a place like this is even open and operating.
Amazing as always! 💕👍 …

Crowded, all the time, for the best reasons.  They have intelligent, committed staff.  Prices, compared to other providers, are more affordable.  They even provide outdoor seating, under shade canopies.  The emerging model of corporate vet medicine are the antithesis of B Street Clinic.  Open every day, with triage, to respond to actual emergencies.  Hence, the long waits for less critical cases.
Thank you for your positive rating. We appreciate your support and look forward to seeing you again!

A warning to pet owners in crisis: Profit over diagnostic accuracy, combined with weaponized administration.

I brought my dog to B Street Veterinary Hospital during a acute emergency involving suspected secondary poisoning from a restricted-use rodenticide (Zinc Phosphide). Instead of receiving calm, competent, and medically sound triage, I was met with aggressive sales-driven pressure and severe diagnostic inaccuracy.

The Medical & Diagnostic Failures:

Lack of Toxicological Knowledge: The staff was entirely unfamiliar with Zinc Phosphide. A practitioner at this clinic attempted to push an expensive "blood rodenticide panel" (a standard PT/aPTT clotting test). When asked repeatedly if this test could actually detect Zinc Phosphide/phosphine gas toxicity (which it chemically cannot, as it only measures anticoagulant pathways), the practitioner could not or would not answer.

Financial Gatekeeping over Care: Before providing any clear diagnostic plan or guaranteeing they could even run the proper toxicology test, the clinic aggressively demanded a upfront $1,000 deposit.

The Administrative Hostility:
When I exercised my legal right as a client to decline an useless test, reject the financial demands, and remove my critically ill dog from their care, the clinic's response was retaliatory. After I declined to return their follow-up calls during the active, devastating loss of my pet, this facility weaponized civil services by calling Animal Control to conduct a retaliatory "welfare check" on my home. The arriving officer quickly assessed the situation, recognized the clinic's report as a baseless administrative power play, and offered genuine condolences for my loss.

If you are facing a complex toxicological emergency or expect transparent, empathetic, and scientifically accurate care for your pet during a crisis, avoid B Street Veterinary Hospital. They operate with the hostile, defensive administrative tactics of a predatory corporate entity.

"To call animal control under the guise of a 'wellness check'—when your team had literally just handed me the referral sheet and knew I was actively transitioning my dog to that exact emergency care facility—is an absolute betrayal of trust during a high-stress crisis. When fighting for a pet's life, a pet owner expects the veterinary team to be partners in care, not a bureaucratic entity hiding behind a legalistic shield to question my integrity and compliance. You knew exactly where I was going because we openly discussed it before I left your practice."

B st vets are amazing and they really help your animals. And the price for your services are the best deal in town! Both my doggies have been looked after from them both are on the mend thank you 😊 🙏 …

The visit went fine, the service from Bernice and Monica was phenomenal as well as the doctor! My biggest issue is the front desk associate Sabrina(the girl with the red hair and glasses), no communication and extremely rude. disgusting attitude right off the bat. She refused to answer any of our questions, completely dismissive to me and other clients. When I asked her about seeing the doctor Sabrina was quick to shut down my questions and blamed me for not answering my phone immediately(when I immediately called back she did not answer the phone). I did not mind having to wait to speak to the doctor, it was the lack of respect given to me and others. It was interesting to see her not only disrespect me but also her coworkers and other customers. She treated every interaction as an inconvenience, and would not stop texting on the phone. She left for a few minutes and when we were called in, the doctor seemed apprehensive when speaking to us like she had told him we were rudely towards her when in fact her lack of professionalism left me in awe. If this issue is not solved, this vet will be losing a lot of money and customers. This entire interaction felt racially charged and I am absolutely appalled by how she treated us. I somehow ended up paying without her explaining to me what it is that i’m paying for or her offering a receipt, no words to let you know she acknowledged you. I was given the medication after paying and still did not receive my animal. All of the front desk workers were running around doing their tasks while she sat on her phone. It is just disappointing to see a place that promotes inclusion and acceptance only to be treated like less than a person. Bernice and Monica did an amazing job helping out with Saint today and I can’t thank them enough! Sabrina should strive to be as hardworking and welcoming as them!
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to know you had a positive experience with us.
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to know you had a positive experience with us.
San Diego is fortunate to have this vet in the community. I felt at ease knowing Dr Olsen was handling my cat’s life threatening issues. Eliah was also wonderful to deal with and so helpful.

We were referred to B Street Vet by our dear friend Billy D and we couldn't be more thankful, our little 14 year old Pug Miyoko had a herniated disk and it was causing her great pain & discomfort, B Street Vet were the most compassionate vet we've experienced over the passed 24 years of being pet owners. They helped her get through the night but unfortunately she took a turn for the worst and we had to say goodbye to her yesterday. Thank you for all your compassion & care and treating our little girl as the sentient being she deserves and not a financial opportunity at the expense of grieving pet owners.

went here on a sunday because i looked up affordable emergency vet after my dog ate some trash and couldn’t keep anything down. this was the closest one open with great reviews. all the reception people were so nice it felt so welcoming and comfortable. super easy process as a first time customer. the wait was obviously long but can be expected with any emergency vet especially on a weekend. they were super informative and upfront about pricing, i’ve never been to an emergency vet before so i can’t speak on how accurate the affordability is. my pup seemed super comfortable after, for sure recommend and might just make this my regular vet myself :)
Very friendly and helpful when I went in for a emergency And needed resources to help cover the cost and they did it with no hesitation to help my dog out
Great experience and great staff
The personal was nice and helpful.

The staff is focused and professional.  I'd say they are very nice a well.  One of the first vet places where I can say that they come across as "they genuinely care" both for you as a pet owner and your wallet, and also for your pet. They had me at hello!

B Street is simply the best Vet Clinic in San Diego. Always so kind, reasonably priced, and knowledgeable staff. Such a valuable asset to our county with the emergency triage they offer, and I know I’m not getting price gouged when I take my pets there. 10/10 service every time!

This place is terrible they basically forced my daughter to surrender my 6 year granddaughters dog after her eye popped out in a dog fight. She scrambled to get help from organizations but it was a weekend .They left the dogs eye out of her head for two days. My daughter tried to remove her and get a second option but they said they would call someone and have her removed because of her eye still being out. This dog is a rare colored Shih tzu and was under two so I believe it was all a scam to just get the dog. I called and pleaded for any kind of help but if your low income and have no credit to get the help then your screwed. The dog was surrendered so she could be helped. My granddaughter still cry’s for her dog that she traveled with from Kentucky.
The story is even deeper than that her uncle who has now passed away gave her that puppy. If I could I would give them a zero. So please don’t listen to the bull about how it’s in the dogs best interest because as you could see she was well cared for , it was housing or the dog….. what a choice to have to make. Homelessness or your dog , if you see Cupcake let her know she is missed dearly.

Referred by my neighbor I took my very sick cat Peter here. Waiting area was packed with customers but they saw me within an hour. Dr. Catala was very caring and detailed. He recommended to hospitalize Peter and after treating him that afternoon called me to bring him home for the night and back the next morning to see the Chief Vet Dr V. They both conferred and examined his blood work results & x-rays. Recommended an antibiotic for pneumonia, probiotic and nausea meds. Peter has recovered and is getting back to himself. They both followed up with emails and phone calls. They gave me the best birthday gift this year. I can't thank them enough and I highly recommend B Street Clinic and their excellent team of vets and vet techs. Also they are truly dedicated to helping your furry friend and not about how much $$ they can make and taking advantage of you when you are upset & vulnerable. Their prices are reasonable and they try to minimize costs. I find that truly heartening. ❤

Best Vet I've ever been to. We are experiencing homelessness. B Street Vet made accommodations so my Baby Girl could be seen. She is doing much better now because of the special care we received at B Street Vet. Special Thanks to Dawn Nielson

The vast majority of the staff I've interacted with here are quite nice, I've only had one not so great interaction over many visits.  Can be a chaotic waiting room experience but partly because this team goes above and beyond for the pets they help.  The front desk employees are so kind and helpful, and the vets/vet techs work so many hours to ensure your pets get the tests they need and you see the test results as soon as they come in.
My dog got into some Easter chocolates and the vets & staff at B street vet were able to quickly rescue him. Very appreciate their prompt and caring service!

We had a very positive experience at B Street (given the circumstances, obviously). We were visiting from out of town when our dog encountered a bush of fox tail, started crying in pain, shaking his head, etc. It was very stressful for our pet and us, and the entire B Street team was kind, patient, and supportive. We did wait a long time in the office, but I prefer that to knowing the care of other pets is being rushed. My dog is always scared of the vet, and being in pain, he was quite frankly, aggressive, but everyone was patient and gentle with him. The procedure and cost were clearly described, and the team answered our questions. Our dog feels much better post surgery.
My only wish, or suggestion for improvement, would be for a Dr to have called in the next day to check in post-surgery and post-anesthesia.
Finally, no one shamed me for engaging in an insane amount of baby-talking to my dog or stress-eating half of the front-desk bowl of candy (human candy, not the dog treats, I did not eat the dog treats).
They were very comforting during the loss of my dog.
Very loving n caring great place.

Beond grateful for Dr.V and her staff. Heartfelt Thanks for jumping in without  hesitation and preforming life saving emergency surgery on my beloved Olivia. We are from Arizona and were faced with unforseen medical emergency with our doggie. While another emergency vet clinic try to take advantage of us, Dr. V and her staff truly cared about getting Olivia better from the moment we came in. Recommended by locals, this place is truly the Diamond Vet care in Sand Diego.

Got us in without an appointment within half an hour on a Sunday for our sick 8 week old golden retriever puppy. They made her feel better told us what was wrong. Got her meds for it and is doing better now because of them. Very affordable for a vets office especially without an appointment.

My beloved cat, Plyusha, passed away at this clinic. They charged me a fortune here, and on top of that, we paid extra for her cremation. They promised us to send the coordinates of where her ashes were scattered. The staff took the money, yet to this day, I have absolutely no information regarding the whereabouts of my deceased cat. What did you do with her—using our money? Here is the rate for you guys.
Thank you for your feedback Michael. We're sorry to hear about your experience and would appreciate any additional details you could provide to help us improve.

Update 2026:

I cannot say enough wonderful things about B Street Vet. From the moment I walked in, it was clear that this is a place that truly leads with compassion.

There was a small sign on the counter surrounded by battery-operated candles that read: if this sign is up, it means someone is saying their final goodbye to their beloved pet, and to please keep noise levels down. Just reading that brought tears to my eyes. It was such a simple yet deeply thoughtful gesture that showed how much they care—not just for the animals, but for the people who love them.

My dog had inhaled a foxtail through his nose, and the team was incredibly thorough in explaining the procedure. They walked me through every possibility of what they might or might not find, which helped ease a very stressful situation.

What really brought me back, though, was an earlier experience. I had originally stopped by to pick up medication for a friend’s cat, but couldn’t find parking. Without hesitation, the staff brought the medication and mobile payment system out to my van. That level of customer service is rare and meant so much.

Because of that experience, I knew exactly where to go when my own dog needed care—and they absolutely delivered.

The entire staff is friendly, helpful, and genuinely compassionate. I truly wish more veterinary offices operated with this level of pride, empathy, and dedication to both pets and their humans.
Jonni Kash , myself and his siblings are furever grateful. 🥰

Exemplary service. Highly, highly recommend.

2025: I was picking up a prescription for a friends cat and they went over and beyond supporting me. I couldn’t find parking and I had my dogs with me so I didn’t want to park blocks away and leave my dogs. I called and they brought the prescription out to me along with the mobile payment system so I could pay right there at the car. I know they didn’t have to do that. I appreciate the fact that they did extra to make it happen. Much appreciated!!!

My first visit was with my minpin Marley. It was an emergency and they took him back immediately and called me to update throughout the
day. Unfortunately I had to return two weeks later for another emergency and even though they were getting ready to close they whisked him back right away. I was given bad news of his heart failure and was given all my options. Deciding to give him a humane end the staff said they'd stay as long as I needed to say goodbye and were the kindest and most incredible people. They stayed with us into the night, never acting upset or rushing me.
When my newer Whoodle pup had a massive seizure I immediately brought her here. No wait, they knew I was homeless and had nothing but Troys care on their mind! They got me to an organization that paid for everything (thank you Pets of the Homeless) and did it with a five minute phone call. Was updated continuously and by the end of the day I got my happy-but tired-baby home.
B St. Vets and staff are caring and compassionate. Knowing my situation never stopped them from giving my fur babies fast, immediate help and they did all the needed services and tests. I never felt like I was looked down upon or a lesser person. Something that many places do.  I can honestly say this is the one place that gave me and mine the most compassionate care and treatment and took absolute amazing care of everyone!

We were referred to this veterinary clinic after a difficult experience in La Jolla, and I am so incredibly grateful we found them. From the moment we walked in, the staff made us feel supported, cared for, and truly understood.

Yes, there can be a wait—but I would wait as long as it takes, because I know my puppies are in the best hands. The level of care and compassion here is unmatched.

We came here trying to help our brown puppy who was born with a cleft palate, and although we sadly lost him, the love and support we received meant everything. Not only from the staff, but even from other pet parents in the room—it felt like being surrounded by family during one of the hardest moments we’ve experienced.

Thank you for treating our babies like your own and for creating a space where people and their pets feel safe, supported, and cared for. We will always be grateful.
Dr. V and the staff are the greatest!!

We always took our dog there for many years. My dog wa attacked  by another dog and her ear was damaged and the vet refused to see dog even though it was not  yet closing time. It was 6 minutes to 4:00, after that im not taking time dog there any more
Thank you for your feedback. We're sorry to hear about your experience and would appreciate any additional details you could provide to help us improve.

UNACCEPTABLE AND HORRIFIC EXPERIENCE.
I brought my puppy to B Street Veterinary Clinic because he had been experiencing diarrhea for several days. During the visit, the clinic suggested doing a simple sanitary clean-up around the rear area to help keep him clean while he was sick. I agreed to a small trim in that specific area only.

Instead, my puppy was returned to me with large portions of his back and half of his beautiful tail completely shaved, along with RAZOR BURNS and visible spots of BLOOD.

For anyone familiar with Pomeranians, this is extremely concerning. Pomeranians have a delicate double coat, and shaving large sections of their coat can seriously affect how their fur grows back. My dog already struggles with slow and uneven fur regrowth, which the clinic was aware of. There was absolutely no reason to shave half of his back and tail for a sanitary clean.

When my dog stands or walks, the damage is extremely obvious. The shaved patches are far larger than anything that was discussed, and his skin looks irritated from the clippers. Seeing my puppy like this was heartbreaking.

I literally burst into tears when they brought him out.

I paid over $500 for tests and medications during this visit, and this is the condition my puppy was sent home in.

I trusted B Street Veterinary Clinic with my dog’s care. What happened today was NOT what I consented to and completely UNACCEPTABLE for a professional veterinary clinic.

I am sharing photos so other pet owners can see exactly what happened during what was supposed to be a routine sanitary trim.

Pomeranians require extra care with their coats, and situations like this should NEVER happen during a routine sanitary clean.
Terrible! Took the dog here and they absolutely ruined his coat and injured him, leaving cuts on his skin. The wait was almost 2 hours. This place should take some serious action or just be closed.
Very cute, everyone is so nice and helpful and most of all comforting. Will return.
I did't actually go here but Google isn't letting my skip it. I'm sure it's spectacular.

I brought my dog in as a walk-in for a broken claw after being told they were affordable and accept walk-ins. Pricing was comparable to other vets in SD, which was fine, but the overall experience was disappointing due to long wait times, lack of communication and unprofessional front desk.

After hours of waiting, I called for an update and was told the vet was “looking at him right now” even though my dog was still with me. He was eventually seen and sent home with pain medication but no explanation and when I asked for more information I was told to check the portal.

The next day he was vomiting and had diarrhea repeatedly after taking the meds. When I called concerned, I didn’t receive a callback until closing time and the only guidance provided was to stop the medication, which was already obvious given his symptoms. The staff member who returned my call was eating while speaking with me, which felt unprofessional given the situation. I ended up having to follow up with his regular vet because of the gastrointestinal issues, I would recommend another vet for proper care and attention.

Best vet hospital
The service is prompt,fairly priced, and the staff
Is super friendly.
Highly recommended

I’ve been coming here for quite a while, but for  the time, meaning I’m now Redirecting myself to a new veterinary hospital I have a pet that has pre-existing conditions that is documented. I called to set up an appointment For my pet to be seen. I came 10 minutes early before my appointment My pet was not seen after waiting 4 Agonizing  hours  I could no longer wait another hour due to work. I’m highly Frustrated I wasn’t able to set a new appointment or be refunded my $65 now I’m left with no help and my pet still hasn’t Received a check up

My cat had a great visit today. He was more at ease today, thanks to some pain medicine he got an hour before coming to the office. We met a different Doctor today and she was very gentle and accomodating with Tadashi.
Compassionate and respectful care. Thank to the staff for being there for us during such a hard time.

Dr. Ma was extremely helpful when our Frenchie ate a bunch of dirt, which required us to induce vomiting. They squeezed us in right before closing and took very good care of her. Dr. Ma was thorough and thoughtful about the process, given the concern about aspiration. I appreciated the help from the front desk staff and Dr. Ma. Thank you!

The overall environment felt chaotic, and it didn’t seem like anyone was fully paying attention or coordinating care.

I had actually been warned ahead of time about the front desk staff being rude, and unfortunately, that turned out to be accurate. The interaction was dismissive and added unnecessary stress to an already concerning situation.

They tried to put a cone on my dog with zero explanation as to why, which immediately felt inappropriate. My dog is literally the epitome of chill - if there was a problem with a previous visit, this was not communicated to me. Despite the fact that I had already sent my dog’s medical records in advance, it was clear they either didn’t have them or hadn’t reviewed them.

I understand veterinary clinics are busy, but the few times I’ve been there felt disorganized and lacking in basic communication and compassion. I won’t be returning.

I needed to leave a review after everything this vet did for me when I lost my beloved dog, Kori. I came in crying and they were quick to help, taking my information and helping my dog out of the car. Despite being in the long line, they were quick to ensure my dog was seen due to the circumstance.
I wish I had gotten names of the staff, but I was so distraught. The vet that had to give me the news of the aggressive tumor had been so compassionate. She did not rush me, nor urge me to one option. When I needed time to call my husband in, she agreed with no hesitation.

When he came to the vet, she ran over everything again. She was attentive, giving us time time to soak in the information and grieve and we tried to make a choice. We struggled for the right choice, but we knew and the fact she assured us we were making the best choice we could for him.
As they prepared him for his final moments, another vet tech (she had color in her hair) came in and equally was kind to us, guiding us through the process. Even got chocolates, cheeses and everything she could find. Though Kori could not eat any of it, I thank you greatly for going above for him.

Those final moments were the hardest I had to endure and the vet tech that was with us, giving the serum, was so kind and gentle with Kori. Petting him with us. Soothing him into the next life. I can't thank this place enough for helping us through this difficult time. All the while the price was shockingly reasonable. It's always a stab in the heart when other places gouge you for so much during a painful time, but not this place.

We chose the option for Kori to be cremated with other animals where he will be released into the ocean with others. I like to believe that he will be able to run with those other animals. He won't be alone as he crosses the veil. Thank you. Thank you so much B Street Vet.
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to know you had a positive experience with us.

Went here through a referral for a cat I have who had had a seizure just before Christmas. They got us in quickly, showed genuine concern about her well-being, and kept us updated throughout the day. Still no idea what caused the seizure and none since, so hopefully a one time thing. I would definitely recommend this clinic to anyone needing urgent care for their pet!

Had a super stressful couple of days before the new year because my boy got into some lilies. I was extremely stressed out since this was the first time I've managed to bring him to the vet and it was for an emergency. However, the staff was always really nice, especially Dr.MC who took over his care. He made sure to call me and check in while my cat was staying for the day, as well as keeping me updated on his overall condition and plan. While the first day was the most stressful (and they were so kind to me while I was anxious and crying), they did a lot to quell my nerves and let me know what was going on and what he needed to get done. Overall, even though it was stress-inducing for both my little guy and me, I'm glad the B street team was there to help us through this!

Some small cons to keep in mind is because they're one of the few places that take emergency walk-ins is that you'll probably be waiting for a long time. Each day just to bring him in, get his labs, and check-in with the Doctor to look at his results took about 4hrs. They operate via severity of cases so if it's just a re-check (like I was doing the last two days) it'll probably take a while to be seen, so just be prepared. Second, is there are only 3 parking spaces in front, with a fourth reserved for accessible parking. I drive a small car so I was always able to fit in the far off spot to the right, but just something to keep in mind. You'll probably need to park on the street.

Lastly, there are no payment plans and fees need to be paid up front and you'll usually over pay a little bit (at least that's what was happening with me).  I understand this is in case there is an unexpected concern they have to treat but since I was really low on funds, having to pay more than was strictly necessary was a little stressful. However, each day I had credit that carried over for the next set of treatments, and got a refund on the last day, so overall fees were lower and lower as his treatment went on. I thankfully had a lot of friends pitch in and was able to pay all his fees without any other issues. If you have care credit or available credit on another credit card, this shouldn't be a concern for you but if you're in a tight financial situation like me (I had just paid over $1k in car repairs and other big expenses...) it's just another thing to keep in mind.

All of that said, again, everyone was still super nice and helpful throughout this and I hope the next time I stop by it's not for an emergency. Thank you all again from me and Mr. Fry <3

Don't go here!  I took my girl in for an injured leg. Asked to have her nails trimmed while she was there. The wait was an estimated 2 hours. After 5 hours the vet said we can give her anti inflammatory. I asked about an exray. “Oh we could do that.”  The tech comes out with an estimate for me to sign, and it included an IV and sedation!  Whoa!  I said give her to me now!  So I paid $100 for NOTHING!  They never even bothered to trim her nails. Just do not go.
Staff is very friendly and knowledgeable! My only complaint is that every time I come, the wait time is much longer than expected.

My dog needed antibiotics and a pain injection. I couldn't afford it. So I told the doctor I was going to bypass the pain med to make sure I could afford the antibiotics. She swore to me that she could get the antibiotics donated. I clarified with her 3 times that I would not be able to afford both yet she insisted that she would get it covered by donation. So she gives him the pain med and at the end she apologized and said she wasn't able to get the antibiotics donated. Straight lied to my face. Luckily I came up with the money. But the topper is she waits until Christmas Eve day and calls to say he needs another antibiotic. I'm like really? All money I had went on presents already. She didn't even try to help out in the second situation. I had my wife return my gift so that my son lives. This place is FOS and money hungry. I will be switching vets. I bought pet insurance now, so their loss.

Definitely the entire building is full of love and caring if you love your animals as much as you as they are part of your family this is the place to go because they will treat you and your furry baby as if it was their own

I can’t comment on the veterinary care as we never ended up being seen by the vet but we had an unpleasant experience waiting to be seen. When we first arrived as a walk in, we were given an estimate of 30 minutes. We were taken back for intake after about 1.5 hours, and another 2 hours later had not been seen yet. I witnessed multiple people asking about wait time and being given incomplete information. I recognize that they are incredibly busy and have to triage based on acuity but just beware of this if planning to take your pet in as a walk-in. I felt uneasy trusting them with my pet’s care and ended up leaving.

This place is the best vet in San Diego, taking walk - in on weekends, priceless. Now, be ready to wait hours even if you have an appointment. I'll do anything for my pets, but waiting that much (about 50 minutes passed my appointment time) it's kind of annoying. Now, once you're out, wait another 20 - 30 minutes to get checked out.
Love the place, but the wait is too much sometimes, specially if you're a walk in. Make an appointment and you'll wait half of the time.
Solid vet, good location, gets a bit busy and parking is city streets
Had an emergency w our dog and they worked us in.  Great judgemental and suggestions by the resident veterinarian
Thank you for your support!
Extremely busy but absolutely outstanding from the moment we arrived until the moment we left. Absolutely went above and beyond our expectations. Absolutely would refer
Excellent care and very helpful and friendly staff.

They were really nice here. They are always so considerate of how my dog is feeling bkuz he's always so scared when we go there. It took a lil longer than usual today but it's ok... I got my dog all taken care of!
Took 5 hours to treat my cat, who only needed an abscess drained and a prescription for antibiotics. Not sure what took them so long, they don’t seem to care here. Do not recommend!!

Edit 4 years later from 2 star to 4 star. They’re better about answering phones and calling back now that it isn’t the height of covid pandemic. Still can take a while for pet to be seen cause they’re still very busy, but it’s soooo useful that they take walk-ins

I hate to give a bad review, but I’ve been very unsatisfied and frustrated with this vet location. I believe they are understaffed, which means they only answer the phone 1/10 times I try calling. They mostly communicate through email, but inconsistently and are often unclear in what they’re saying, which requires me to ask for clarification, and then waiting around for either a few hours to a few days for a response. The inconsistency is very frustrating. The vet is very nice, but she talks a lot it and quickly and doesn’t give me a chance really to ask questions or voice my opinion. When I came to pick up my cat, it took 45 minutes waiting in the lobby just to get her and check out. For the past few days I’ve been trying to get in contact with them about starting a new medication for my cat and I just can’t get in contact with them and I don’t have the time to go wait in person for who knows how long to speak to anyone. I think just the main issue was they are understaffed and way too busy being a walk-in clinic while also taking appointments.

Dr. Olsen is the best! She is very caring and takes the time to explain everything. She is thoughtful and kind, which is so needed when your fur baby is hurting. The staff overall are fantastic and all trying their best. It seems like a high stress environment to work in, and they do a great job making sure people and their pets are cared for.
Always kind & compassionate

Prices are reasonable, but the wait times are not. Staff is nice, but they can mislead you with the amount of time needed and have you waiting all day long if you don't complain. When you do complain their standard go to response is: "We had an emergency situation that needed to take priority over your pet... ", which sends you and your pet to the end of the line.  When you do complain about how they manage things... they respond with "if you don't like it here you are more than welcome to go somewhere else". Going somewhere else really wasn't an option as I had already spent a lot of money our cat's treatment plan and starting from zero somewhere else would have been too much for my budget.

Sadly, our pet passed away recently... the attention and care I got overall was okay, but not the best. Maybe you just get what you pay for.  Expect long wait times, you can drop off your pet and come back late in the afternoon, don't bother waiting around just ask them to call you back when the pet is ready to be picked up. If I had the money to pay for better quality and care I would go somewhere else. The only thing reasonable are their prices, which I found to be less expensive than most other places.

I'm writing this report a bit upset that our pet passed away, and I find myself thinking what we could have done better, and I'm not sure if going elsewhere would have made a difference. My only advice to B Street would be to manage expectations and time management better. Don't leave your customers and pet hanging around all day long, pets get stressed when they wait too long too not just customers, and when your customers complain... accept the complaint rather than telling your customers to go elsewhere.

Update: Very lovely card was sent to us, thank you.

I took my cat with worm problem & was given medication for it. Medicine worked great & she is well. The attending vet there was awesome & so we’re the staff front desk. Definitely recommend this place.

This Vet & Hospital is AMAZING! Ure really lucky if you live near & this gets to be ur pets vet! My Mom dropped & broke my dogs vial of Vetsulin. We just relocated to Mt. Helix & haven't been lucky enough to find a vet I like & can afford near by. The local La Mesa animal hospital referred me to B Street, after they told me they don't stock Vetsulin. Went to B street, which is quite a ways for me, but was extremely delighted to find that the front office personnel; a happy, smiling, friendly & knowledgeable young man informed me that yes, they do have the vial of Vetsulin they can sell me & simply charge me a fair & very reasonable price for a well check visit. I think the visit was just UNDER $100 & the Vial of Vetsulin was just OVER $100. My pooch & I were in and outta there within an hour & for just a couple bucks over $200! THANK YOU ALL SOO VERY MUCH. IF I CANT FIND A REASONABLE VET I LIKE CLOSER TO US, Ull be seeing us again❤️👏❤️🙌🏼❤️🐾❤️ Way ta go on the excellent handling of our situation! Major kudos!
They took care of my furry friend 🧡 Thank you so much!!! …

I went to this vet office this weekend because no other vet was open near by. I unfortunately had to put my little one down 😢. The doctor and staff that attended my little dude was extremely compassionate and caring. They even sent me a little momento to keep and always remember my dog. Thank you guys so much for your service and your compassion. You guys are amazing.
Very friendly and helpful, had a pet emergency and they were available to see my dog and took great care of him. Thank you for helping take care of our community’s animals

Called before I went they said little to no wait time, I went and their sign out front said fill out form only check in at desk if it’s 0800. Filled the form waited 15 min so I walked in and they said you have to check in both places. Then I sat there and waited for almost 2 hours. I walked in and they said 15 more minutes. I waited 20 more minutes and they never came out so I walked back inside and they said oh we were about to call you but if you want to leave then go ahead. Just really unprofessional and not pleased with the service or how it is ran.

Great vet, just too damn crowded and bad parking...I have to update this to a 2 star, because you shouldn't have to wait an hour just to pick up the same meds every month. If you value your time, this is not the place...It will test your patience to the fullest so unless you are retired and don't have anything better to do.... DON'T DO IT!!
I truly appreciate the staff here. They really love animals and it shows.
These vet work very hard at what they do .and they are really good at what they do because your dog is there dog. Been with Bstreet clinic for 13 years ...

What a terrible place top to bottom. From the 10+ people I’ve interacted here at this place over the course of a month, I spoke to two people who actually seem kind and understanding. Everyone else is rude and bad at their job. The person whose practice I assume this is yelled at a staff member my first visit in the middle of the lobby. There is zero privacy to discuss sensitive issues like payment and personal information for you or your pet. You will be told to “take a seat, the doctor will be with you shortly” just to wait 8 hours to get any update on your pet. They made me pay for anesthesia to drain an abscess in the back of my cat’s throat just to be told that it had to be done yet again a week later because they think there’s something lodged in there now even though they could have done that the first time. I’ve never felt so taken advantage of and disregarded as a pet owner in my life. I regret ever coming here. What a waste of money for my cat to still be sick.

1) It’s been years and they can never keep vaccine records for my dogs straight no matter how many times I ask for clarification.  I even ask for emailed records but what they’ve sent me doesn’t line up with what they told my new vet over the phone. How do they have different vaccine dates when they always get them together?

2) This office told me one of my dogs has a heart murmur and needs major knee surgery when I brought her in for a limp. 3 different doctors have seen her since and none of them detected a heart murmur. I even asked the last doctor to check again. My dog also came back from her new vet without a limp. They told me she does have arthritic joints but no need for surgery, at least not for a long while.
they dont even answer the phone

Avoid this hospital unless you can get an appointment. The walk in process is insanely frustrating. I’ve been waiting to see a doctor since 750am and it’s 1pm on a Friday. The lady right in front of me was seen hours ago and only came in for a routine vaccination while my pet is here for an allergic reaction. AVOID this place. I will be changing my pets to another vet since every time I call they provide inaccurate information regarding their past visits. It doesn’t appear they know how to review their own documentation

Not worth the cheap prices...super overcrowded & disorganized with long wait times. They'll find extra things to charge you on anyway so you end up paying more than original estimate. Go somewhere else.

They also coned 1 of my cats who has never had aggressive issues at previous vets saying that he was being "spicy" but it makes me wonder how they treated him for him to react that way.

This place is the best, my dog was bit on a run but another misbehaved dog, pretty deep right next to his eye. When I heard they had to sedate him to sew it up and he was gonna need a bunch of meds, I was expecting it to be at least $1000 for an emergency visit. It ended up coming in at $50 less than the estimate at only $500. You can tell they actually care about animals and not profits here. Highly highly recommend!

They were great!! Took my 🐕 here because she was attacked by a neighbors dog. They took her in for treatment right away, and it was even on a Sunday. Staff was very friendly, Dr explained everything in detail, and the bill was reasonable. Thanks again!
Update: Still very good, but be prepared to wait for hours. 2 weeks ago I waited for 8 hrs to be seen and yesterday it was about 5 hrs (for a recheck).

I am very happy to have found B Street Vets. We have two dogs and the vets and staff at B Street have taken great care of our family. B Street allows walk-ins without appointments, and sometimes they have a lot of walk ins waiting, but they will always triage the animals and make sure your pet is cared for. When you have an appointment, there is no problem getting in. It is a busy clinic and the staff always does their best to be welcoming even when it gets hectic.

I'm very confused on why this is listed as affordable?? In what way? They called me back to tell me an office visit is $95, I said my kitty has an abcess and she said it would be $1600-$2000 for an extraction? I thought this was a specialty dental clinic I had called....i double checked and its "affordable B street vet" uhh no. I'm not sure if this woman was high or what. But reading the other reviews ab how pets have died after coming here and her giving me absolutely outrageous prices, it's looking like we should listen to the 1 star reviews.

Dr B is the best she saved my friends dog life because he ate poison seed that expanded in his stomach she just the dog and knew what was wrong and I am so grateful because she saved my life and she saved his life the dog ate poison and saved his dog he’s so grateful

In short; I wouldn’t recommend taking your fur baby here. I could write or state the reason but some experiences aren’t worth the time to write. If you love your fur baby I suggest you find a more suitable place to go.
Just called and was extremely put off by how rude the lady was that answered the phone. I will not be taking ANY of my animals here

I have been going here for years and they are seriously the best. They take such good care of my dogs and the staff & Drs are so kind, understanding, and caring. The only down side is they are too freaking popular, it's so hard to get a scheduled appointment, but if you show up early you can get on the  walkin wait list.

ABSOLUTELY NOT. Do not bring your precious pets here if you can help it!!! We went in for bloodwork to initially check for anything out of the norm. They said it would take a couple of days to get the results. In the process of closing out at the front desk, one of the techs aggressively pushed for me to buy my dog an antibiotic. Why?? I was confused because no one mentioned meds at all during the appointment. She claimed that he "could maybe have a UTI and it would help with any discomfort." I told her that I'll wait for the test results to be sure. The tech continued to push to get me to buy the antibiotic and shook her head at me when I refused to pay for the meds.

I sensed something was very off and bluntly let her know I was ready to pay what was due and leave. I never went back and never will go there again.

My dog was actually experiencing symptoms due to a mass/tumor that had grown on his spleen. I found that out in one single appointment at another amazing animal hospital in Point Loma (go there instead). I recommend always getting a second opinion if something doesn't seem right.

Note: ultrasounds are amazing for finding internal lumps and bumps (also more affordable than x-rays). Ask for an ultrasound and review all test results in detail. Above all, stay away from this pushy and rude B Street Vet Hospital. I don't believe for a second that they have genuine intentions to care for our pets.
